## Problem

## Requirements

- Given an integer array `nums` plus an integer window length `k`, compute the maximum for each consecutive block containing `k` elements.
- Return those maxima in the order the windows are encountered from left to right.
- The intended approach must outperform independently iterating through every window.
- Implement the following API:

```text
maxSlidingWindow(nums, k)
```

## Notes

- This question was paired with another difficult array task in a coding interview, making efficient use of time important.
- Be prepared to discuss `k == 1`, `k == len(nums)`, repeated maximum values, and arrays containing negative integers.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Use a monotonic deque to maintain candidate maxima in decreasing order within the current window.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

As the window slides, remove elements that fall out of the window from the front and add new elements while maintaining the deque's order.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

The front of the deque always holds the current window's maximum, giving O(n) overall time.

</details>
